gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.dst) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header (game 'Tetris: DS', name 'Everything Unlocked'), then 896 bytes of block-RLE-compressed save (1 blocks decoding to 8 KiB: the 8 KiB EEPROM)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 8192 --stem 'Tetris DS (USA, Australia)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 8192-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
